description: This Java source file defines the 'UnknownSignalException' class, a specific type of runtime exception used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter to indicate that a particular signal is not supported by the adapter. It includes methods for building exceptions from messages and JSON objects, as well as a nested builder class for fluent exception construction.

classes.name: UnknownSignalException
classes.description: A specialized runtime exception indicating an unsupported signal in the protocol adapter, with factory methods for construction and a nested builder class for customizable exception creation.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an UnknownSignalException instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnknownSignalException instance by extracting information from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the method to set headers on the exception, returning a new exception instance with updated headers.
